measurements.evidence_quote: The zeta potential of untreated PS bead was -28.7 ± 1.7 mV owing to the presence of anionic sulfate groups on the beads but was changed to 28.0 ± 4.3 mV after treatment with positively charged chitosan, and then became -2.6 ± 0.4 mV after TA treatment (Fig. 2e). || In range of pH 6–8 (pH of drinking water), trend of zeta potential values according to surface treatment was similar to the trend in DI water shown in Fig. 2e. || The size and zeta potential of the beads based on the surface modification were measured using a Zetasizer (Nano ZS90, Malvern Instruments).
